newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept by BP, two deferred - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept by BP, two deferred - trade.

text.p: A Brent cargo loading on June 12-14 which passed through the paper chains on Wednesday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline by BP, traders said.
The cargo was earlier heard to have been kept by Rheinoil but it was fed back into the chains, they said.
Another Brent cargo, originally deferred from June 9-11 to June 12-14, was deferred again, while a third cargo was also deferred, traders said.
